decision: The frozen stable-underside source passed the complete native mechanical/edit/assembly gate. The delivered source changes only four drawing leaders; its two independent blank replays per recipe, non-drawing parity, corrected sheet equality and reviewed print-input equality are recorded separately. No physical print, fit, retention, startup, output or durability rating is claimed.

superseded_previous_record.reason: Historical 1622-step, 9-printed-definition, 19-occurrence turbine and its live replay predate the 11-definition, 71-occurrence bearing/generator/assembly redesign. That evidence does not qualify this candidate.

source_revision_note: The sources array identifies the delivered drawing-only revision. The full mechanical wrapper ran on the separately listed frozen recipe and test revisions. Final-source replay/parity connects the delivered files to that baseline; it does not relabel the older wrapper as rerun on the final source.

checks: Two independent blank native replays compare complete exports, including models, scenes, sketches, assembly and drawings.
Stage plate thickness 3 to 4 mm preserves both occurrence placements through stable underside references; cold reload and restoration agree.
Driving shaft-bore edits update actual geometry and associative drawing dimensions, then restore.
The 4:1 relation moves actual rigid groups and hardware from either shaft, including forward, reverse and multi-turn poses.
Native interference covers home, 20 quarter-degree sub-tooth samples through 5 degrees, 24 fifteen-degree full-turn samples, additional turns and reverse drive.

Forty-four modeled fastener insertion routes, nut preload order, tool access, bearing contact/endplay/stops, wire route and enclosure sequence use actual native geometry, with wrong-order and interference negative controls.
Selected print meshes are closed and consistently oriented, contact the bed, and match solved native placements; a mirrored-surface negative control rejects false equivalence.
frozen_mechanical.boundary: Motion and insertion paths are discrete native samples; they do not prove continuous contact, deformed behavior or physical durability.

checks: Independent native source/catalog replay and cold geometry
Four individual positive native poses and canonical four-part layout
Closed meshes and oriented surface matching
frozen_coupon_fit.final_source_boundary: The final coupon source changes one radial leader; independent replays and non-drawing parity are recorded separately.

main.scope: Complete new-source blank native replay repeated twice, exact baseline geometric/assembly/print identity, and separately reviewed radial-label-only drawing change. Frozen-source full mechanical wrapper remains separate.

coupon.native_zip_writer: Production src/files/nbcad.ts createNbcadArchive/readNbcadArchive; every model payload roundtripped exactly. JSON serialization preserves signed zero.
coupon.scope: Complete new-source blank native replay repeated twice, exact baseline geometric/assembly/print identity, and separately reviewed radial-label-only drawing change. Frozen-source full mechanical wrapper remains separate.

final_source_replays.scope: Complete independent blank replays of both final recipes and exact non-drawing model, scene, assembly and print parity to the frozen baseline. This is separate from the frozen full mechanical wrapper.

drawings.scope: All 18 native SVG sheets were visually reviewed. Four leader positions were corrected without changing dimensions, feature associations, meshes or poses. The 36 final SVG/DXF files must match those reviewed exports exactly.

slicer.process: Bambu Studio 02.08.02.61; X2D main 0.4 mm; PETG HF; 0.2 mm standard; 2 walls; 15% infill; support disabled; arrange 0
slicer.surface_equivalence: The 16 final archives must match actual reviewed G-code inputs by exact numeric coordinates and oriented triangles, allowing only index order and cyclic triangle rotation; no alignment, rounding or geometry edit.
slicer.base_roof: The rejected circular roof left an unsupported wall. Corrected circle-preserving 45-degree relief and a 1 mm ceiling provide 0.220 to 0.224 mm direct prior-layer wall overlap in 96 samples, followed by a 2.930 mm maximum bridge move including anchors. Physical bridging remains unqualified.

live_validation.scope: The frozen stable-underside native model was opened, saved as an owned review copy, visually inspected in complete and isolated-drive views, restored exactly, saved with its expected filename, then closed. This is a native-model review, not a new script replay or physical turbine test. The later four drawing leaders were not part of this live build; final-source parity is recorded separately.
live_validation.historical_boundary: The September 10 attached replay applies only to its superseded source. This live review opened the mechanical baseline; it is not a full attached construction replay of the final drawing-only source.

remaining: Measure generator case length, terminals, shaft projection and actual hardware.
Print and measure fit coupons and roof/bridge features on the intended material/profile.
Qualify bearing retention, clamp slip, runout, assembly access and rotor balance.
Anchor the base and measure startup at multiple angles, RPM and simultaneous voltage/current under known electrical loads.
Qualify creep, fatigue, wear and weather/overspeed measures before any outdoor variant.

design.generator: Vernier KW-GEN3 reference; case, terminals and shaft projection require specimen measurement.

rejected_previous_run.finding: Changing the stage plate from 3 to 4 mm moved both top-face-attached occurrences by -1 mm. Stable underside references corrected the attachment; initial printable geometry was unchanged.
